answer: PLONK proof of unique personhood is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 454 fakes spends 8172 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Hold the zephyr up to the light, weigh the pearl of the attack, and keep the harbor of the verdict where everyone can audit it. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
